user.title: SmartSchool credential
user.description: Paste the values from the browser's loginByBio request (see the integration documentation for how to capture them).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect SmartSchool
reauth_confirm.description: Your saved credential is no longer accepted. Paste fresh loginByBio values for the same SmartSchool account. Your existing integration and entities will be kept.

data.confirm_account: This is the same account — continue anyway

error.invalid_auth: The credential was rejected. Check the values and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to SmartSchool. Try again later.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.already_configured: These device credentials are already used by another SmartSchool integration.
error.wrong_account: None of the students this credential can see match the ones already set up, so it may belong to a different SmartSchool account. If it is the same account (for example after the school year changed), tick the box below and submit again. To add another account, use Add Integration instead.

abort.already_configured: This SmartSchool account is already configured.
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The SmartSchool integration being reauthenticated no longer exists.

init.title: SmartSchool options
init.description: How often to check SmartSchool, and whether to monitor the message inbox.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between checks (15-360). Each check is a few requests to SmartSchool.
data_description.messages_enabled: When off, the inbox is not polled and the message sensors are unavailable.
